nodes.name: Build Enrichment Prompt
nodes.notes: Prompt asks AI for: customerType, potentialValue (INR), confidence %, recommendedProducts, segmentTags, reasoning

nodes.name: Parse Enrichment Result
nodes.notes: Parses AI JSON response. Falls back to defaults if AI response is malformed.

nodes.name: Update Customer Metadata
nodes.notes: PUT /api/customers/:id — persist enrichment: customerType, potentialValue, recommendedProducts, segmentTags

meta.description: Triggered by customer.created. Calls AI to analyze customer (based on phone, email, name, company, territory). Enriches: customerType (INDIVIDUAL/RESELLER/SMB/ENTERPRISE), potentialValue (INR LTV estimate), recommendedProducts, segmentTags. Updates customer metadata. Falls back to defaults if AI fails.
